regressionEvidence: Independent monotonic clock probe advances beyond parent deadline without firing its timer; child checkpoint rejects. Focused transport test and inherited-expiry admission fences also pass.
findings.reviewerResult: Approved; independent auth-r2 passes 11/11, including the named regression. Corrected complete frozen 76/76 passes; original source review decision remains preserved.
